US Inflation Data and Bank Earnings to Shape Market

Investors are closely watching the upcoming release of the US Consumer Price Index report for September, alongside major bank earnings, as key factors expected to influence Wall Street. The data will be crucial in assessing the likelihood of a Federal Reserve interest rate hike in December. US markets have recently shown weekly gains, with these economic indicators and corporate results anticipated to drive future trading.
